_meta.about: Channel registry for the miniature pipeline (make_film.mjs). The niche itself (scope, titlePatterns, thumbnailPatterns, shorts, seoKeywords, radarBuckets) lives in runtime/topics/niches.json under `niche`; tagline/channel below are checked against it. Per-film end lines live in films/<film>/channels.json (see `endLine`), written by the script-writer agent, never by hand.
_meta.perFilmFile: films/<film>/channels.json = {"<key>": {"name": "<Channel Name>", "line": "NARR (plain, dry): <last fact line>. Like the video, and subscribe. <name sentence>"}}; variants.py reads exactly this shape
_meta.rule: From 2026-11-15 each film is made for ONE channel: one entry in the film's own channels.json, one variant. The two-version rule applied only to nvidia_v4, china_v4, trump_v4.

powder.name: Powder Keg
powder.voice: deadpan, forensic, 'how did nobody notice'; follow one object (the memo, the ledger, the invoice) to the payoff

endLine.format: NARR (plain, dry): <last fact line>. Like the video, and subscribe. <name in its own sentence>
endLine.nameSentence: This channel is called Powder Keg.
endLine.why: MINIATURE-LESSONS 23: otherwise the name check hears 'Powderkeg' instead of the two words
endLine.source: script-writer agent (longform-writer skill) only; never self-written

powder.uploadFooter: How it blew up. Subscribe to Powder Keg.
powder.risk: defamation: name living people only with charges, filings or rulings; skip allegation-only and private-individual topics

partition.name: Partition Lines
partition.tagline: The lines on the map that move money
partition.scope: geo-economics of borders, chokepoints and trade routes
partition.voice: calm, concrete, money-first; follow one cargo, ship or price through the line

endLine.format: NARR (plain, dry): <last fact line>. Like the video, and subscribe. <name sentence>
endLine.nameSentence: This channel is called Partition Lines.
endLine.why: variants.py stage `voice` checks the name is heard as separate words in order (large-v3)
endLine.source: script-writer agent (longform-writer skill) only; never self-written

partition.uploadFooter: The lines on the map that move money. Subscribe to Partition Lines.
partition.risk: skip war tactics, casualty and prediction topics; ad-safe framing, no war words in thumbnails
